title: Technical Trainer
description:
Technical Trainer (Consultant) – Latin America

CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content, and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge and, for 119 years, has helped innovators mine, assess, and apply that information to keep businesses thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious, and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.

CAS is seeking an independent consultant to deliver technical training and product consulting services for CAS scientific information solutions in Latin America (based in Brazil). This is a contract-based engagement.

The consultant will provide pre- and post-sale technical training and product consulting to users of CAS solutions, including SciFinder, BioFinder, and STNext, with a focus on Life Sciences content.

Services will include:

Training & Enablement

  • Prepare and deliver instructional materials for technical training events, user meetings, and conferences.
  • Conduct on-site and virtual sessions to educate customers on CAS solutions and best practices.
  • Design customized educational content tailored to customer workflows and needs.

Consultative Support

  • Provide product consulting to help customers maximize adoption and value.
  • Collaborate with ACS International teams as needed to align training with strategic objectives.
  • Offer insights on AI-driven features and innovative functionalities within CAS solutions.

Customer Engagement

  • Facilitate onboarding and continuous learning for CAS users.
  • Gather feedback and communicate actionable insights to ACS International for product improvement.
  • Support initiatives that promote customer success and solution optimization.

Strategic Communication

  • Deliver compelling presentations at workshops, seminars, and industry events.
  • Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed under the engagement.

Required Expertise:

  • Proven experience in designing and delivering technical training programs.
  • Strong ability to simplify and communicate complex scientific concepts.
  • Familiarity with CAS solutions (SciFinder, STNext) and other scientific information platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Skilled in virtual training tools (Teams, Zoom, WebEx) and CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX).

Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, or a related discipline (preferred focus on drug discovery or pharmaceutical development).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical training, customer success, or product consulting.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Spanish proficiency is a plus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Location & Travel

Based in Brazil; with regional travel within Brazil and across Latin America required up to 20% of the time.

This is an independent consulting engagement. The consultant will be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business expenses. Duration, deliverables, and compensation will be agreed upon in the consulting contract.

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 

Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:

O Grupo Capital:

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.

Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.

Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 

Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.

Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.

Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 

Pré-requisitos:

  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Diferencial:

  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.

Você terá:

  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.

Modo de contratação:

  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital

Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.

Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.

Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: Especialista em Ciências de Dados

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor de Busca)
description:

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.

Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking.   • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.

Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch

  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).

  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.

Perfil esperado

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a senior-level Full-Stack PHP Developer who thrives on solving real problems, takes full ownership of systems, and communicates clearly and thoroughly. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys digging into existing applications, understanding how they actually work, and improving them with pragmatic, well-reasoned solutions.

You’ll work on production SaaS systems built primarily on PHP 8 and CodeIgniter , spanning application logic, data modeling, and frontend integration. We value engineers who think end-to-end, explain their reasoning, and treat the product as if they own it.

What You’ll Do

  • Own application features and fixes from start to finish — from investigation and design through implementation and rollout
  • Deep-dive into existing PHP/CodeIgniter codebases to debug issues, improve reliability, and reduce technical debt
  • Design and implement new features with attention to maintainability, performance, and clarity
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering peers, clearly explaining tradeoffs, risks, and decisions
  • Improve application architecture incrementally (schemas, services, controllers, APIs)
  • Participate in production issue triage and root-cause analysis when needed
  • Proactively identify improvements rather than waiting for tickets

Core Technical Requirements

  • Strong experience with PHP 8 in production environments
  • Hands-on experience with CodeIgniter (or deep familiarity with similar MVC PHP frameworks)
  • Solid background in LAMP-style stacks (Linux, MySQL/MariaDB, PHP, Apache/Nginx)
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
  • Comfortable working across backend and frontend boundaries
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, AJAX, and modern browser behavior
  • Strong SQL skills and experience designing/debugging relational schemas

Nice-to-Have (Not Required)

  • Familiarity with Redis, Elasticsearch, or similar data stores
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, basic DevOps workflows, or cloud hosting (AWS/GCP/etc.)
  • Experience modernizing legacy PHP applications
  • Familiarity with containerized or service-oriented deployments

What We Care About Most

  • Ownership mentality — you don’t just “complete tasks,” you take responsibility for outcomes
  • Problem-solving depth — you like understanding why something broke, not just patching it
  • Verbose, clear communication — you explain your thinking, document decisions, and surface risks early
  • Comfort working independently without constant oversight
  • Strong judgment when balancing speed vs. correctness

Experience Level

  • 5+ years professional experience building and maintaining PHP applications
  • Proven track record working in real production systems (not just greenfield demos)

Working Environment

  • Results-focused culture: outcomes matter more than hours
  • Remote-friendly, globally distributed team
  • High trust, low micromanagement
  • Direct access to decision-makers and real influence over technical direction

Why This Role

  • Real systems, real users, real problems
  • Autonomy to improve code and architecture meaningfully
  • Opportunity to be a true owner , not a ticket-taker
  • Competitive compensation with room for growth

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director) - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!

Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain "Brilliance or Nothing" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and "breaking" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the "click" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the "Stream Team" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and "elite" visual identity across all platforms.

Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and "breaking" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted "fellow degen" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.
Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.

If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant - Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Analista de infraestrutura
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

Atuar com Application Packaging e Deployment em ambientes Windows, sendo responsável pela criação, atualização e implantação dos clientes AppGate, IBOSS e Infoblox via Microsoft Intune . O foco principal será garantir implantações estáveis, automatizadas e em conformidade. Quando não estiver envolvido em atividades de packaging, apoiará as rotinas do time EUC Shield .

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Criar e manter pacotes de aplicações para Windows.
  • Realizar deployment de aplicações e atualizações via Intune .
  • Desenvolver automações com PowerShell .
  • Garantir compliance e configuração adequada dos endpoints.
  • Documentar processos e apoiar a transição (KT/shadowing).

  • PowerShell avançado .

  • Conhecimento em endpoint compliance e configuration management.
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente!!

Habilidades Comportamentais:

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!

Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.

Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Java para atuação em cliente Atos de forma remota.

Habilidades Técnicas

  • Domínio avançado da linguagem Java: Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, generics), JVM, garbage collection e otimização de performance.
  • Frameworks e bibliotecas: Spring Framework (Boot, MVC, Security), Hibernate/JPA, e conhecimento em alternativas como Micronaut ou Quarkus.
  • Padrões de design e arquitetura: SOLID, design patterns (Singleton, Factory, Observer), arquitetura de microsserviços, RESTful APIs e event-driven architecture.
  • Bancos de dados: SQL avançado (queries complexas, otimização) e ORM (Object-Relational Mapping).

Ferramentas e DevOps

  • Ferramentas de build e versionamento: Maven/Gradle, Git/GitHub/GitLab, CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Testes e qualidade: JUnit, Mockito, TestNG, TDD/BDD, cobertura de testes e ferramentas de análise estática (SonarQube).
  • Containerização e orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes, e conceitos de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Onebridge, uma empresa Marlabs, é uma consultoria global de IA e Análise de Dados que capacita organizações em todo o mundo a alcançar melhores resultados por meio de dados e tecnologia. Localização : Brasil – Remoto

Indústria : TI & Serviços

Lead Software Engineer | Sobre Você

Como Lead Software Engineer, você é responsável por impulsionar a visão técnica por trás de aplicações modernas e escaláveis, enquanto orienta uma equipe de engenharia de alta performance. Você prospera na interseção entre arquitetura, desenvolvimento prático e mentoria, equilibrando decisões estratégicas com a paixão por construir software de excelência.

Você gosta de definir padrões de engenharia, elevar as capacidades da equipe e tomar decisões conscientes que influenciam o sucesso do produto a longo prazo.

É motivado(a) por resolver desafios técnicos complexos e criar ambientes onde os engenheiros possam realizar o seu melhor trabalho.

Lead Software Engineer | Atividades do Dia a Dia

  • Liderar o design e desenvolvimento de aplicações complexas e escaláveis usando .NET e frameworks modernos de JavaScript, como Angular ou React.
  • Definir padrões de engenharia, melhores práticas e diretrizes arquiteturais para a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Arquitetar e manter sistemas na nuvem seguros, de alta disponibilidade e otimizados para desempenho.
  • Colaborar com equipes de Produto, QA e DevOps para garantir alinhamento entre as soluções técnicas e os objetivos de negócio.
  • Orientar engenheiros, promovendo aprendizado contínuo, qualidade na execução e compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Realizar revisões de código para garantir aderência aos padrões de qualidade, segurança e manutenibilidade.
  • Resolver desafios técnicos avançados e influenciar decisões relacionadas à arquitetura e seleção de tecnologias.

Lead Software Engineer | Habilidades & Experiência

  • 7+ anos de experiência em engenharia de software, com proficiência avançada em .NET e frameworks modernos de JavaScript (Angular ou React).
  • Experiência comprovada liderando equipes de engenharia e colaborando efetivamente entre diferentes áreas.
  • Forte expertise em TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 e padrões modernos de desenvolvimento web.
  • Experiência prática no deploy e otimização de aplicações na AWS ou outras grandes plataformas de nuvem.
  • Conhecimento profundo de arquitetura de sistemas, padrões de design e princípios de aplicações escaláveis.
  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança e comunicação em inglês, tanto escrita quanto verbal.

title: Regional Sales Manager, Brazil (Chinese speaking)
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a country manager with entrepreneurial spirit and strong results orientation, responsible for building and leading the company's business in the LATAM region from scratch. This is a unique high-impact position suitable for sales leaders who crave challenges and autonomy. You will be responsible for developing market entry strategies, establishing key partnerships, building high-performance sales teams, and driving significant revenue growth. Your success will be directly rewarded through an unlimited commission structure.

Main responsibilities

  • Partnership Development : Proactively identify, approach, and build strong relationships with strategic partners, affiliates, communities, and key opinion leaders (KOLs). Maintain high outreach velocity and continuously expand a quality partner network.
  • Business Growth & KPI Achievement : Drive regional performance by improving key commercial metrics related to customer acquisition, engagement, and overall revenue contribution. Deliver measurable business impact through disciplined execution and performance tracking.
  • Full BD Process Ownership : Independently manage the entire BD lifecycle - prospecting, qualification, negotiation, follow-ups, closing, and post-deal maintenance. Ensure fast execution and a healthy pipeline.
  • Client & Partner Relationship Management : Build and maintain long-term, trust-based relationships with partners. Increase engagement, retention, and contribution through proactive and high-frequency communication.
  • Market Research & Competitive Insights : Monitor regulatory updates, competitor strategies, user behaviour, and market dynamics in the LATAM region. Provide actionable insights and identify new partnership opportunities.
  • Localized Marketing Collaboration : Work closely with marketing teams to support localized content, community engagement, and event initiatives. Ensure smooth and effective execution across Portuguese-speaking markets.re all sales and partnership activities comply with local regulations and company policies.

Job requirements (must be met)

  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in sales or business development, capable of independently acquiring and converting clients.
  • Strong execution, self-discipline, and ability to work effectively in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to maintain long-term relationships and manage high-frequency partner interactions.
  • Good command of English and Portuguese for business communication (Mandarin proficiency is a strong plus).
  • High resilience and emotional stability under pressure and rejection.
  • Existing partner, affiliate, community, or KOL resources that can contribute value in the short term.
  • Experience in digital platforms, online services, fintech, or other performance-driven industries, or strong personal familiarity with similar ecosystems.
  • Strong hunter mindset: bonus-driven, results-oriented, and motivated by performance-based outcomes.

We provide

  • Uncapped Income Potential: An attractive compensation package that includes a generous base salary and more importantly an uncapped commission structure that directly rewards your performance.
  • Autonomy and Influence: Freedom to form your own team and develop strategies for the entire region. Your decisions will directly affect the global success of the company.
  • Career Development: This is a senior leadership position where you will have great career and financial advancement opportunities as the company grows.
  • Global Environment: Work with a diverse international team to serve customers worldwide.
  • Remote work flexibility: can work from anywhere in the world.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.

You Are

An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.

Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.

  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction
Qualifications
  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

description:

Important Information

Job Summary

This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.

Essential Skills

  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

title: DevOps Azure (Realocação para Portugal)
description:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

What will you be doing?

  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery;

title: Privacy Counsel (Full Time, Remote Position)
description:
About VeraSafe:

VeraSafe is an innovative and successful U.S. headquartered privacy and cybersecurity compliance consulting firm and law firm. Due to rapid growth and increased demand for our international privacy and technology compliance and legal services, VeraSafe is seeking creative, motivated, and collaborative attorneys to join our team, regardless of prior work experience or education background. This is a fully remote position and will remain a fully remote position.

Watch / listen to learn more about VeraSafe: Check out our podcast!

Apple Podcast :

YouTube :

Spotify:

VeraSafe is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work©, with 96% of our employees affirming that we are truly a great place to work . This means we foster trust, collaboration, and a positive work environment. We are committed to maintaining this standard of meaningful work, work-life balance, and a supportive community. Check out our great benefits, listed at the end of this job description.

VeraSafe frequently hires for attorney and consultant positions on a rolling basis. We are growing rapidly and seek to proactively build a strong talent pool to meet sustained, increasing client demand.

About the Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for an attorney with 4-6 years of experience who wants to join a team working on the cutting edge of privacy and data protection, and who wants to further develop a practice in an in-demand, high-tech area of law. We are inundated with business from clients who love the way we advise on privacy compliance (hence the need for you!).

While this role requires professional experience in privacy law , we are prepared to welcome you to our team with a robust and established onboarding and training process. We typically advance people more quickly than your typical law firm, and we do it on an individual basis (no lockstep promotions or compensation).

Note : We include skills assessments in the recruitment for this position. We know this is a burden, but we think it’s worth it, and we appreciate you taking the time to complete it. We’ve found it enables us to find the best attorneys, regardless of their experience, where they went to law school, or where they were trained. We want smart, kind, creative lawyers, plain and simple, and this assessment is a crucial part of our ability to hire this way.

We are not your typical legal job. We use project managers to keep our remote team organized and our projects streamlined and on-track. We encourage our team members to travel and to make use of our ability to work as digital nomads, whether that means spending a few months abroad or on extended trips to be near family. We collaborate closely (you won’t feel like you’re working in isolation) and we actively encourage sharing of credit for work well done, resources, and advice (and penalize the reverse). We are not biglaw. We do top-notch work for interesting clients, yet we pride ourselves on our team members being happy, with time and energy for a life outside of work, which we believe makes us better attorneys who don’t burn out.

The bottom line: If you want to learn or go deeper practicing privacy law, if you want to practice in a problem-solving environment focused on giving excellent and yet actionable advice, if you want to work with a global team of friendly, brilliant people, if you want the flexibility to work in a way that makes sense to you, please apply!

Responsibilities Include:

  • Assessing client information systems for compliance with data protection laws and regulations
  • Drafting data protection agreements, addenda, and amendments
  • Advising clients on privacy-related product improvements
  • Researching legal issues and composing legal opinions/memoranda
  • Writing privacy law related articles and blog posts
  • Assisting in the development of in-house legal templates
  • Contributing to the development of internal procedures and methodologies
  • Collaborating with a team of intellectual peers who value cooperation and community

What We Need From You

Need to Have:

  • License to practice law (active and in good standing) in your jurisdiction
  • Experience in privacy/data protection of 4-6 years or experience in the field of life sciences of at least 4 years
  • Team player, interested in contributing to a growing enterprise
  • Strong writing/editing skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work remotely
  • Willingness to learn new skills and receive direction and feedback from partners
  • Willingness to pursue privacy certifications (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPM)

Nice to Have:

  • Experience working in a law firm
  • Previous contract drafting and negotiation experience
  • Privacy certifications of some kind (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPP/US, specialty from law school, etc.)
  • Professional involvement in the privacy and/or data security space (attendance at privacy conferences; membership or publication in the IAPP, etc.)

Key Competencies:

  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a strong work ethic
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable using a variety of software applications
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage your own schedule in order to work successfully with international teams and meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently and fully deliver on all commitments

VeraSafe’s Excellent Benefits Include:

  • Work from almost anywhere with Wi-Fi
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid holidays
  • Annual bonuses
  • Membership in the International Association of Privacy Professionals (IAPP) and IAPP exam fee reimbursement (CIPP/E)
  • Flexible working schedule in some roles
  • Reimbursement for certain personal flight ticket
  • Company laptop provided

Other Benefits:

  • Tremendous professional development growth opportunities in the privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity niche
  • The chance to have a long-lasting effect on a small but growing international business
  • Work in an open environment with a team that respects your ideas and contributions
  • Occasional opportunities to travel in North America and Europe

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect

Role: Senior Software Engineer

Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.

About the role

Own and evolve critical payments/back-office services end-to-end: design, build, ship, and operate API-first Python systems that automate disputes/chargebacks and related workflows. You’ll partner directly with clients and internal teams to translate business rules into reliable integrations, services, and data models— leveraging Linux, with a pragmatic DevOps mindset.

Responsibilities

  • Lead project execution: technical design, implementation plans, code reviews, and delivery coordination.
  • Build and operate REST APIs in Python (versioning, idempotency, auth, webhooks, integrations).
  • Own API integrations with external partners/processors: onboarding, validation, retries, error handling, and SLAs.
  • Implement complex payments/chargeback business logic from requirements and client workflows; ensure correctness and auditability.
  • Model API/domain data with strong data-structure fundamentals (schemas, invariants, normalization/denormalization tradeoffs).
  • Develop and maintain client-facing device intelligence instrumentation in JavaScript where needed (collection, privacy controls, performance).
  • Meet and maintain contact directly with clients.
  • Operate services on Linux: deployments, debugging, performance tuning, incident response, and reliability improvements.
  • Contribute to DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, safe rollouts, observability (logs/metrics/traces), and operational automation.

Required

  • Expert Python backend engineer (3.12+ preferred): strong typing, testing, concurrency fundamentals, and performance debugging.
  • Proven REST API development experience (design + production operations), including integrations and webhooks.
  • Strong data structures and API data modeling skills (clear contracts, backward compatibility, validations).
  • Experience implementing business logic for payments/fintech workflows, especially disputes/chargebacks and reconciliations.
  • Comfortable on Linux servers with a DevOps mindset (deploy/run/debug production services; automate operational work).
  • Client-facing technical communication: can interface with external stakeholders to clarify requirements, diagnose issues, and drive resolutions.
  • Ownership mentality and interest in leadership: drive the full lifecycle from discovery → design → build → operate.

Nice to have

  • JavaScript experience beyond basics (instrumentation, performance, privacy-aware collection) for client integrations.
  • Containerization/orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), IaC (Terraform), and cloud-native operations on Amazon Web Services.
  • Event-driven/workflow systems (SQS/Kafka/Kinesis; Airflow/Prefect/Dagster).
  • Security/compliance exposure (PCI, SOC 2) and observability tooling at scale.

How to apply

Send an English resume and links to relevant work (repos, API docs, architectural notes, or write-ups) showing:

  • Python backend API development + real-world API integrations
  • Payments/disputes/chargebacks or similarly complex workflow automation
  • Linux/DevOps experience running production services
  • Any JavaScript instrumentation work and client-facing delivery experience

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Norte
description:
Sobre a vaga

Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Norte

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.

Missão da função

Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.

Reporte e interfaces

  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno

Principais responsabilidades

Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)

  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.

Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial

  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.

Negociação e fechamento

  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.

Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado

  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.

Metas e indicadores (referência)

  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.

Diferenciais (alto peso)

  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).

Exclusividade e conflito de interesses

  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.

Modelo de remuneração

  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.

Suporte da Mobiis

  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position, CLT model, salary range 16k-22k BRL/mo (DOE).

Must-Haves:

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • Strong AWS experience, including EC2, Security Groups, command line usage, and ECS Fargate
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins (CI/CD pipelines, automation, etc.)
  • Hands-on Terraform experience — both command line and coding — to build cloud infrastructure, create/modify resources, and update security group permissions following existing patterns
  • Linux environment expertise: Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & automation skills (Packer, Terraform, or Ansible preferred)
  • Strong critical thinking — must be able to take tickets and work independently without heavy guidance
  • Excellent communication and proactive updates; must know when to escalate or ask for help
  • Experience reviewing and remediating vulnerability and FinOps tickets (cost optimization, workload cleanup, etc.)

Plusses:

  • Windows experience

Day-to-Day:

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products by managing permissions, handling access requests via Slack, and troubleshooting one-off operational issues as they arise. You will assist with releases for new services and perform ongoing patching and maintenance across cloud infrastructure, primarily within an Amazon Linux environment. Using AWS services such as EC2 and Security Groups, along with Terraform for infrastructure as code, you will follow established configurations to build, modify, and maintain cloud resources. The role also requires writing scripts to support automation and deployment workflows, collaborating closely with engineering teams to ensure stable and secure operations. While the environment is mostly Linux-based, there may be occasional interaction with Windows systems, though this is secondary to the core responsibilities.

title: Senior Account Manager - Installed Base (IB) BIJ
description:
This role is responsible for managing the installed base of Business Inkjet Printers in Brazil. A key mission is to ensure the right balance of sell-in to channels while guaranteeing that sell-out performance aligns with the actual print volume of the total installed base. The position requires strong analytical and commercial skills to optimize portfolio performance, protect channel profitability, and support market growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform supplies sales in collaboration with the Channel Account Manager, ensuring commercial alignment and consistent execution across the channel.
  • Monitor sales performance, inventory levels, margins, and profitability across the supplies portfolio.
  • Analyze the installed base against our AMPV to determine true ink-consumption potential by machine type.
  • Evaluate attach rates by sales channel and support sell-in planning to ensure full alignment between purchasing, demand, and the installed base.
  • Develop and track promotional activities to drive sell-in and increase channel engagement.
  • Support marketing and communication initiatives that reinforce the use of original supplies, highlighting risks and impacts associated with non-original products.
  • Conduct price-positioning, elasticity, and competitiveness analyses for each category.

We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
